prompt: Rewrite this invitation to sound informal but considerate: 'Attendance is requested at a modest gathering to commemorate completion of the garden shed. Refreshments will be provided. Guests may arrive after four and should not consider bringing a gift obligatory.' Use approximately 120 words for the response.
text: We’re having a small, relaxed get-together to celebrate finally finishing the garden shed, and we’d love for you to come by. Drop in any time after 4:00 for a look around, a chat, and some refreshments. Nothing fancy—just a chance to enjoy the finished project with friends and neighbours. Please don’t feel any pressure to bring a gift; your company is more than enough. Feel free to come as you are and stay for as long or as little as suits you. We hope you can join us for a drink, a few snacks, and a cheerful toast to the shed’s completion.
